You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Le Gardien du Phare",
  "slug": "le-gardien-du-phare",
  "lang": "fr",
  "gameType": "stage-clear",
  "loop": "Glissez le doigt autour de la tour pour tourner le faisceau et éclairer les bateaux avant qu'ils touchent les rochers. Ramenez tous les bateaux d'une nuit au port pour passer à la nuit suivante ; un bateau échoué termine la partie.",
  "input": "drag-follow",
  "style": "paper-cut"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `drag-follow`

# Drag follow

The player presses on a piece and it trails the pointer until release. Good for steering, sorting and placing.

- Register `pointerdown`, `pointermove` and `pointerup` on the canvas and capture the pointer on press. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Convert client coordinates to canvas coordinates with `getBoundingClientRect()` and the device pixel ratio.
- Ease towards the target instead of snapping, so small jitters do not shake the piece.

```js
let held = null;
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  held = pieceAt(toCanvas(event));
  if (held) canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
  if (held) held.target = toCanvas(event);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
  held = null;
});
```

Drop the piece on `pointercancel` as well, so a system gesture never leaves it stuck to the finger.

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `paper-cut`

# Paper cut

Everything looks cut from coloured card and stacked in layers.

## Palette

| role       | colour    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| background | `#f4ecd8` |
| layer      | `#e07a5f` |
| accent     | `#3d405b` |
| highlight  | `#81b29a` |

## Primitives

- Filled paths with slightly irregular edges: jitter each vertex by one or two pixels, seeded once so it does not flicker.
- One soft shadow per layer: `shadowBlur` around 6 and a small downward offset.
- Rounded rectangles and circles for pieces; stacked copies offset by a few pixels suggest depth.
- Text in a heavy system sans-serif, drawn on a card-shaped plate.

## Avoid

- Gradients, glows and outlines thicker than two pixels.
- Pure black; use the accent colour for the darkest tone.
- Photographic textures or anything loaded from a file.

### Card `stage-clear`

# Stage clear

The player meets a stated goal to clear each stage. Clearing the last stage wins; failing a stage loses.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `optional`    |
| level                | `required`    |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `win, lose`   |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: a `level` on entering each stage and an `end` when the play-through finishes. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- Use only `win` or `lose` as the `end` reason. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Stages

Number stages from 1 and step by one. Show the goal on screen when each stage opens ("Light 5 lamps"). Make stage 1 easy enough to clear on the first try.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let stage = 0;
function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  buildStage(stage);
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}
function onGoalMet() {
  if (stage === STAGES.length) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win" });
  else enterStage(stage + 1);
}
function onStageFailed() {
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
}
```

Give the player a few seconds of grace at the start of each stage before any threat can finish it.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll create the lighthouse guardian game now.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Le Gardien du Phare</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden; background: #f4ecd8;
    touch-action: none;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  canvas { display: block; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

// ---- Setup ----
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

let W = 0, H = 0, DPR = 1;
function resize() {
  DPR = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width = Math.round(W * DPR);
  canvas.height = Math.round(H * DPR);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

// ---- Palette ----
const COL_BG = "#f4ecd8";
const COL_LAYER = "#e07a5f";
const COL_ACCENT = "#3d405b";
const COL_HILITE = "#81b29a";

// ---- Seeded jitter helper for paper-cut edges ----
function mulberry32(a) {
  return function () {
    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
const jitterRand = mulberry32(1337);
function jitterPoly(points, amt) {
  return points.map(p => [p[0] + (jitterRand() - 0.5) * amt, p[1] + (jitterRand() - 0.5) * amt]);
}

function drawPaperPath(pathPoints, fillColor, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(61,64,91,0.35)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
  ctx.fillStyle = fillColor;
  ctx.beginPath();
  pathPoints.forEach((p, i) => {
    if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(p[0], p[1]);
    else ctx.lineTo(p[0], p[1]);
  });
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function roundRectPoints(x, y, w, h, r) {
  return [
    [x + r, y], [x + w - r, y], [x + w, y + r],
    [x + w, y + h - r], [x + w - r, y + h], [x + r, y + h],
    [x, y + h - r], [x, y + r]
  ];
}

// ---- Game state ----
let paused = false;
let screen = "title"; // title, playing, stageIntro, gameover, win
let stage = 0;
let score = 0;
let beamAngle = 0; // radians
let beamTarget = 0;
let held = false;
let graceTimer = 0;
let introTimer = 0;
let ships = [];
let shipsToSave = 0;
let shipsSaved = 0;
let lastTime = 0;
let stageGoalText = "";

const STAGES = [
  { count: 3, speed: 0.10, spawnGap: 2600 },
  { count: 4, speed: 0.13, spawnGap: 2200 },
  { count: 5, speed: 0.16, spawnGap: 1900 },
  { count: 6, speed: 0.19, spawnGap: 1600 },
  { count: 7, speed: 0.22, spawnGap: 1400 }
];

const lighthouseCenter = () => ({ x: W / 2, y: H / 2 });
const towerRadius = () => Math.min(W, H) * 0.10;
const rockRadius = () => Math.min(W, H) * 0.46;
const portRadius = () => Math.min(W, H) * 0.14;

function backToTitle() {
  screen = "title";
  stage = 0;
  score = 0;
  ships = [];
}

function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  const cfg = STAGES[stage - 1];
  shipsToSave = cfg.count;
  shipsSaved = 0;
  ships = [];
  spawnTimerAcc = 0;
  spawnGap = cfg.spawnGap;
  shipSpeed = cfg.speed;
  stageGoalText = "Sauvez " + shipsToSave + " bateau" + (shipsToSave > 1 ? "x" : "");
  screen = "stageIntro";
  introTimer = 2.2;
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}

let spawnTimerAcc = 0;
let spawnGap = 2000;
let shipSpeed = 0.1;

function spawnShip() {
  const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
  const r = rockRadius() + 40;
  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  ships.push({
    angle: angle,
    dist: r,
    speed: shipSpeed + Math.random() * 0.03,
    lit: false,
    id: Math.random()
  });
}

function onGoalMet() {
  if (stage === STAGES.length) {
    CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
    CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win" });
    screen = "win";
  } else {
    enterStage(stage + 1);
  }
}

function onStageFailed() {
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
  screen = "gameover";
}

// ---- Input (drag-follow style, adapted to rotate beam) ----
function toCanvas(evt) {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    x: evt.clientX - rect.left,
    y: evt.clientY - rect.top
  };
}

function angleFromCenter(pt) {
  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  return Math.atan2(pt.y - c.y, pt.x - c.x);
}

canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  if (screen === "title") {
    startGame();
    return;
  }
  if (screen === "gameover" || screen === "win") {
    backToTitle();
    return;
  }
  held = true;
  const p = toCanvas(event);
  beamTarget = angleFromCenter(p);
  canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
});
canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
  if (held) {
    const p = toCanvas(event);
    beamTarget = angleFromCenter(p);
  }
});
function releasePointer() { held = false; }
canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", releasePointer);
canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", releasePointer);

function startGame() {
  screen = "stageIntro";
  score = 0;
  CARTRIDGE.send("start");
  enterStage(1);
}

// ---- Update ----
function angleDiff(a, b) {
  let d = (b - a) % (Math.PI * 2);
  if (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  if (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return d;
}

function update(dt) {
  if (screen === "stageIntro") {
    introTimer -= dt;
    if (introTimer <= 0) {
      screen = "playing";
      graceTimer = 2.5;
    }
    return;
  }
  if (screen !== "playing") return;

  // ease beam angle towards target
  const diff = angleDiff(beamAngle, beamTarget);
  beamAngle += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 8);

  if (graceTimer > 0) graceTimer -= dt;

  spawnTimerAcc += dt * 1000;
  if (spawnTimerAcc > spawnGap && ships.length < shipsToSave - shipsSaved + 2) {
    spawnTimerAcc = 0;
    if (ships.length + shipsSaved < shipsToSave) spawnShip();
  }

  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  const beamWidth = 0.32;

  for (let i = ships.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = ships[i];
    // check if lit
    const ad = Math.abs(angleDiff(beamAngle, s.angle));
    s.lit = ad < beamWidth;

    if (s.lit) {
      // move inward towards port
      s.dist -= s.speed * 60 * dt * 0.6;
    } else {
      // drift towards rocks
      s.dist -= s.speed * 60 * dt * 0.15;
      // wobble angle a bit
      s.angle += Math.sin(performance.now() / 900 + s.id * 10) * 0.0015;
    }

    if (s.dist <= portRadius()) {
      ships.splice(i, 1);
      shipsSaved++;
      score += 10;
      CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
      continue;
    }

    if (s.dist <= towerRadius() + 6 && graceTimer <= 0) {
      // hit rocks near tower means wrecked (too close without being saved through port logic distance)
    }

    if (graceTimer <= 0 && s.dist <= towerRadius() * 1.4 && !s.lit) {
      // wrecked on rocks (rocks ring visually near tower not edge; use inner threshold when unlit for too long)
    }
  }

  // Wreck detection: if unlit ship distance falls to rock-ring band while not making progress to port
  for (let i = ships.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const s = ships[i];
    if (graceTimer <= 0 && !s.lit && s.dist < rockRadius() * 0.5) {
      // shipwreck!
      ships.splice(i, 1);
      onStageFailed();
      return;
    }
  }

  if (shipsSaved >= shipsToSave && ships.length === 0) {
    onGoalMet();
  }
}

// ---- Draw ----
function drawBackground() {
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_BG;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  // subtle stars
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(61,64,91,0.15)";
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const sx = (i * 97.3) % W;
    const sy = (i * 53.7) % H;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx, sy, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawRocks() {
  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  const r = rockRadius();
  ctx.save();
  const n = 22;
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
    const rr = r + (jitterRand() - 0.5) * 14;
    pts.push([c.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, c.y + Math.sin(a) * rr]);
  }
  drawPaperPath(pts, "#c98a6b");
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawPort() {
  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  const r = portRadius();
  const n = 16;
  let pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
    pts.push([c.x + Math.cos(a) * r, c.y + Math.sin(a) * r]);
  }
  pts = jitterPoly(pts, 3);
  drawPaperPath(pts, COL_HILITE);
}

function drawBeam() {
  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  const len = rockRadius() + 60;
  const spread = 0.32;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f2e9c9";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y);
  ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, len, beamAngle - spread, beamAngle + spread);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawTower() {
  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  const r = towerRadius();
  let pts = roundRectPoints(c.x - r * 0.6, c.y - r * 1.3, r * 1.2, r * 2.2, 6);
  pts = jitterPoly(pts, 2);
  drawPaperPath(pts, COL_LAYER);

  // top cap
  let capPts = [
    [c.x - r * 0.75, c.y - r * 1.3],
    [c.x + r * 0.75, c.y - r * 1.3],
    [c.x + r * 0.4, c.y - r * 1.7],
    [c.x - r * 0.4, c.y - r * 1.7]
  ];
  capPts = jitterPoly(capPts, 2);
  drawPaperPath(capPts, COL_ACCENT);

  // lamp dot
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#f2e9c9";
  ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(242,233,201,0.8)";
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(c.x, c.y - r * 1.4, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawShip(s) {
  const c = lighthouseCenter();
  const x = c.x + Math.cos(s.angle) * s.dist;
  const y = c.y + Math.sin(s.angle) * s.dist;
  const size = 16;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.rotate(s.angle + Math.PI / 2);
  let hull = [
    [-size * 0.5, size * 0.4],
    [size * 0.5, size * 0.4],
    [size * 0.35, -size * 0.4],
    [-size * 0.35, -size * 0.4]
  ];
  hull = jitterPoly(hull, 1.5);
  drawPaperPath(hull, s.lit ? COL_HILITE : COL_ACCENT);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawUI() {
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
  ctx.font = "bold 18px sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText("Nuit " + stage, 16, 30);
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 16, 54);
  ctx.fillText("Sauvés: " + shipsSaved + "/" + shipsToSave, 16, 78);
}

function drawTitle() {
  drawBackground();
  drawRocks();
  drawPort();
  drawTower();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 34px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Le Gardien du Phare", W / 2, H * 0.28);
  ctx.font = "18px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Glissez le doigt pour tourner le faisceau", W / 2, H * 0.35);
  ctx.fillText("Guidez chaque bateau au port avant les rochers", W / 2, H * 0.40);
  ctx.font = "bold 22px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Touchez pour commencer", W / 2, H * 0.55);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawStageIntro() {
  drawBackground();
  drawRocks();
  drawPort();
  drawTower();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 30px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Nuit " + stage, W / 2, H * 0.4);
  ctx.font = "22px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(stageGoalText, W / 2, H * 0.48);
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGameOver(msg) {
  drawBackground();
  drawRocks();
  drawPort();
  drawTower();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.font = "bold 30px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText(msg, W / 2, H * 0.4);
  ctx.font = "20px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Score final: " + score, W / 2, H * 0.48);
  ctx.font = "bold 20px sans-serif";
  ctx.fillText("Touchez pour recommencer", W / 2, H * 0.56);
  ctx.restore();
}

function draw() {
  if (screen === "title") {
    drawTitle();
    return;
  }
  if (screen === "stageIntro") {
    drawStageIntro();
    return;
  }
  if (screen === "gameover") {
    drawGameOver("Bateau échoué !");
    return;
  }
  if (screen === "win") {
    drawGameOver("Toutes les nuits éclairées !");
    return;
  }
  drawBackground();
  drawRocks();
  drawPort();
  drawBeam();
  drawTower();
  ships.forEach(drawShip);
  drawUI();

  if (graceTimer > 0) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_ACCENT;
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.font = "18px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Préparez-vous...", W / 2, H * 0.15);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

// ---- Main loop ----
function frame(t) {
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (t - lastTime) / 1000 || 0);
  lastTime = t;
  if (!paused) {
    update(dt);
  }
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

// Boot: draw first frame, then send boot
draw();
CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Le Gardien du Phare", gameType: "stage-clear", lang: "fr" });
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
